meta.project: Hi Line Pro Care Backend API

product_overview: Hi Line Pro Care provides backend APIs for a public e-commerce store and an authenticated admin portal. The service supports browsing products, placing orders, validating coupons, managing saved addresses, and administering orders and product listings.
core_goals: Enable customers to browse active products and view product details
Allow customers to place orders with shipping and contact information
Support coupon validation and access to authenticated saved addresses
Provide secure admin authentication for operational tasks
Let admins manage orders and product catalog entries

features.name: Store API
features.description: Public-facing store operations for product discovery, pricing validation, address lookup, and order placement.
user_flows: GET /api/trpc/store.getProducts with optional filters -> Receive 200 with a list of active products -> GET /api/trpc/store.getProductBySlug with a valid slug -> Receive 200 with product details -> POST /api/trpc/store.createOrder with customer info, shipping address, and items -> Receive 200 with order confirmation

GET /api/trpc/store.getProducts with a malformed or injection-like filter -> Receive 4xx validation or safe failure response -> GET /api/trpc/store.getProductBySlug with an invalid slug -> Receive 4xx or not-found response -> POST /api/trpc/store.createOrder with missing payload or invalid data types -> Receive 4xx validation error

POST /api/trpc/store.validateCoupon with a valid coupon code -> Receive 200 with coupon validation result -> POST /api/trpc/store.validateCoupon with an expired or invalid coupon code -> Receive 4xx or 200 with invalid coupon status
GET /api/trpc/store.listAddresses without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> GET /api/trpc/store.listAddresses with a valid auth token -> Receive 200 with saved addresses

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Authentication service used by admins to obtain access to protected administrative endpoints.
user_flows: POST /api/trpc/auth.localAdminLogin with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with authentication token or session data -> GET /api/trpc/admin.listOrders with valid auth -> Receive 200 with orders list

POST /api/trpc/auth.localAdminLogin with missing payload or invalid credentials -> Receive 4xx unauthorized or validation error -> GET /api/trpc/admin.listOrders without auth -> Receive 401 unauthorized response

features.name: Admin API
features.description: Protected administrative operations for viewing, updating, creating, and deleting commerce records.
user_flows: GET /api/trpc/admin.listOrders with valid admin auth -> Receive 200 with array of orders -> POST /api/trpc/admin.updateOrderStatus with a valid order identifier and status -> Receive 200 with updated order -> GET /api/trpc/admin.listOrders again -> Receive 200 reflecting the updated status

POST /api/trpc/admin.createProduct with valid product data -> Receive 200 with created product details -> POST /api/trpc/admin.updateProduct with the created product data changes -> Receive 200 with updated product details

GET /api/trpc/admin.listOrders without authentication -> Receive 401 unauthorized response -> POST /api/trpc/admin.updateOrderStatus with invalid data types or missing payload -> Receive 4xx validation error -> POST /api/trpc/admin.deleteOrder with a non-existent order id -> Receive 4xx not-found or error response
